note: The journal's job times (design 8.1 S1-S6 as amended by cross-design Y21 and Y22). Times are IST HH:MM on the vector's day and null means the job does not run that day; a runner case gives the job, the moment it is asked, what job_run already holds and the status it writes (null: it does not run). The calendar files are synthetic.

vectors.note: a normal trading day: brief 08:45, day report 15:45, close check 16:05 (after the cash post-close session), excursions 17:00, catch-up 22:00
the Muhurat session of Sunday 8 Nov 2026 (window 14:05-15:40): the brief at its own start less 30 minutes, 13:50, never 08:45 (mutation target 19); the Sunday digest too
a weekday holiday: no trading job runs (mutation target 20); the catch-up does
a Sunday without a session: the weekly digest still runs
1 April 2027: the FY pack and the monthly statement both at 07:00; F&O closes at 15:45 from 7 Dec 2026, so the day report is at 15:50
the service down at 15:45 and up at 17:00: the day report runs at 17:00, marked late
a job_run row of the day stops a second run
a failed run is asked again 15 minutes after it, not before
a failed run is asked again 15 minutes after it
on time: the day report at 15:45
the brief missed until the day's last close does not run
before its time a job does not run
